items.expected_literal:
Test passes only when both of the following hold within a single
pytest invocation: (1) MAX_RETRIES env is at least 3 (the pinned
convergence floor), and (2) the pytest-rerunfailures --reruns
argv provides enough attempts for the file-persisted attempt
counter to reach MAX_RETRIES within a single pytest invocation.
If either knob is under-configured, the test fails deterministically
with a diagnostic message naming the under-configured knob.
